problems.explain: Adding 9 to every value slides the whole set along: the mean goes up by 9, and every distance from it stays the same. (The center moves; the spread does not.) So it stays 9.

prompt.v: A data set has a standard deviation of 9. Every value is multiplied by 2. What is the standard deviation now?

problems.text: sd change: sd 9, times 2; options same, plus, times
problems.explain: Multiplying every value by 2 stretches every distance from the mean by 2 too, so the spread becomes 2 × 9 = 18. (The mean is multiplied as well, but the spread is about distances.) So it becomes 18.
